reasons: Claimed status (missing) is supported: the cited General Provisions paragraph (10.8 Headings; Counterparts) shows no insurance covenant, and the vendor hosts the Site and handles Confidential Information, so the rule applies.
Redline is a clean insertion of a new Section 10.9 in the miscellaneous section, leaving p0070 text untouched — the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position.
Inserted language matches the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for data processing, statutory workers' compensation, term plus one year, and certificates on request.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the rationale, and offers the stated fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and an insurance obligation is present in the result.
